summary: postinstall auto-executes bundled Windows launcher loading virus.jar with startup persistence
details: package.json declares a postinstall script that runs a shipped Windows PE launcher (DakuMangalSingh/DakuMangalSingh.exe, ~452KB) alongside an embedded JRE. The launcher's jpackage configuration points at app/virus.jar with main-class 'Main'. The JAR contains classes named Fetch, Executor, BatchExecutor, RobotService, Screenshort, DeviceId, and Main — the shape of a remote-command implant that fetches instructions, executes them, captures screenshots, and collects device identifiers. A bundled replicate.bat creates a.lnk shortcut for DakuMangalSingh.exe and copies it to %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup, giving the launcher persistence across reboots. package.json has empty author/description fields and the tarball ships no source — only the opaque binary payload invoked at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
